description: Set up Cargo workspace and implement the core library crate with all types, manifest parser, scanner modules (R0-R13), finding-merge (C3), ruleset-loader (C1/C2), and reporters (terminal, json, markdown, sarif). This is the bulk of the rewrite - porting packages/core/ to Rust.
steps: Create Cargo.toml at workspace root (/projects/sandbox/skill-scanner/Cargo.toml) defining a workspace with members = ['crates/core', 'crates/cli']. Add workspace-level dependencies: serde, serde_json, serde_yaml, regex, uuid, chrono, walkdir, clap, reqwest, tokio, thiserror, colored.
Create crates/core/Cargo.toml for the skill-scanner-core library crate with dependencies: serde, serde_json, serde_yaml, regex, uuid, chrono, walkdir, thiserror.
Create crates/core/src/lib.rs as the library entry point, re-exporting all public modules.

Create crates/core/src/types.rs implementing all core types: Severity (P0/P1/P2 enum), Tier (blocker/suggestion/nit enum), CriticalTag enum, ThreatCategory enum, RuleOrigin enum, ScanFinding struct, SkillManifest struct, CapabilityDeclaration struct, ScanContext struct, ScanResult struct, ScannerModule trait (with fn scan(&self, ctx: &ScanContext) -> Vec<ScanFinding>), RulesetTrustPolicy enum, RulesetMeta struct. All structs derive Serialize/Deserialize/Clone/Debug.

Create crates/core/src/manifest.rs implementing: parse_manifest(skill_path) -> Result<SkillManifest>, parse_manifest_with_raw(skill_path) -> Result<(SkillManifest, String)>, normalize_manifest(manifest) -> SkillManifest, parse_skill_md_frontmatter(content, skill_path) -> SkillManifest, validate_manifest_structure(manifest) -> Vec<String>, extract_declared_capabilities(manifest) -> HashMap, extract_declared_domains(manifest) -> HashSet. Port the YAML frontmatter regex extraction and all normalization logic from the TS version.

Create crates/core/src/engine.rs implementing ScannerEngine with register(module), scan(skill_path) -> Result<ScanResult>. Port the collect_source_files walker (using walkdir crate, ignoring node_modules/.git/dist/build/coverage/.quickwork). Implement create_default_engine() factory that registers all scanner modules.

Create crates/core/src/modules/mod.rs and individual module files: manifest_validation.rs, network_diff.rs, fs_diff.rs, process_spawn.rs, dangerous_api.rs, secrets_scan.rs, narrow_waist_bypass.rs, sbom_cve.rs. Each implements the ScannerModule trait. Port all regex patterns and detection logic from the TS counterparts. The sbom_cve module should shell out to 'npm audit --json' (same as TS version) using std::process::Command.

Create crates/core/src/finding_merge.rs implementing merge_findings(core, customs) -> Vec<MergedFinding> and decide_from_findings(findings) -> Decision. Port the severity-asymmetry guarantee (C3), the identity-key grouping, and all defensive guards (reject custom claiming core origin, etc.).

Create crates/core/src/ruleset_loader.rs implementing validate_ruleset(input, source) -> Result<Ruleset> and origin_for_load(opts) -> RuleOrigin. Port the C1 schema validation (rule ID regex, message length cap, strict unknown-field rejection, tier/severity enum validation) and C2 origin stamping. Use serde for deserialization with deny_unknown_fields.

Create crates/core/src/reporter/mod.rs, terminal.rs, json.rs, markdown.rs, sarif.rs. Each implements a Reporter trait with fn render(&self, result: &ScanResult) -> String. Port the terminal colored output (using colored crate), JSON (serde_json::to_string_pretty), markdown table format, and SARIF 2.1.0 schema output.
Create crates/core/src/formatter.rs implementing format_finding(), format_report(), is_blocked(), requires_acceptance() - the legacy formatter functions.

Create crates/core/src/marketplace/mod.rs, types.rs, registry.rs, local_adapter.rs, skills_sh_adapter.rs, clawhub_adapter.rs. Define MarketplaceSource trait (can_handle, fetch), FetchedSkill struct, MarketplaceRegistry. Port the local adapter (sync fs ops), skills-sh adapter (git clone via Command), and ClawHub adapter (HTTP via reqwest with redirect following, max 5 redirects).

Add unit tests in each module file using #[cfg(test)] mod tests. Port key test cases from the TS test files: manifest normalization tests, finding-merge C3 tests (severity asymmetry, adversarial custom rule rejection), ruleset-loader C1/C2 tests (valid/invalid rulesets, origin stamping).
Copy the existing test fixtures directory (packages/core/src/tests/fixtures/) to crates/core/tests/fixtures/ so integration tests can reference them.
acceptance_criteria: cargo build -p skill-scanner-core compiles without errors
cargo test -p skill-scanner-core passes all unit tests
cargo clippy -p skill-scanner-core -- -D warnings shows no warnings
The core crate exports all public types and functions needed by the CLI crate
All scanner modules (R0-R13) are implemented with regex patterns matching the TS originals
Finding merge correctly enforces C3 severity asymmetry (custom cannot downgrade core)
Ruleset loader validates C1 schema constraints and stamps C2 origins
All four reporters produce correct output format
findings: All verification steps pass: cargo build, cargo test (32 tests), cargo clippy -D warnings (no warnings). The url crate was added as an additional dependency for host extraction in the network_diff module. The ClawHub adapter HTTP fetch is stubbed since reqwest is not a core dependency - the CLI crate will provide the actual HTTP implementation via reqwest.
